list: the official 55 trophies, enriched with hidden flags, kinds, roadmap stages and cited guides in the guide's own words

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. There is no extra task of its own: A Long Road, the Gold for 100% completion, is the last gate for most players, so treat the roadmap as the plan and let this one arrive on its own.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies.
A Long Road (100% completion) is usually the final one.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, through to its end. It is the first mission of Chapter 1 and unlocks automatically as the story opens, so you cannot miss it by playing the main path.
steps: Start a new game.
Play through Gone Fishing until the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Nothing optional is needed for it: keep playing the main path and it pops at the chapter's end. Do the Chapter 1 meditation for Positive Mental Attitude before you leave the chapter.
steps: Complete all Chapter 1 story missions.
Before the chapter ends, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. From here both Jason and Lucia are playable, which opens up the partner trophies and the shared meditation spots.
steps: Complete all Chapter 2 story missions.
Use the new two-character play to start partner activities.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter: the game has no mission replay, so a save is your only way back.
steps: Make a manual save at the start of Chapter 3.
Complete all Chapter 3 story missions.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. After this chapter only the final mission stands between you and the story's end, so make a manual save here too.
steps: Make a manual save at the start of Chapter 4.
Complete all Chapter 4 story missions.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. It is the last story beat, so it lands once Chapter 4 is done. Save before it: the 100% completion checklist opens after the story, and a save here lets you mop up cleanly.
steps: Complete Chapter 4.
Make a manual save before the final mission.
Play the final mission to its end.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It is a main-path mission, so it unlocks as you play through the story and cannot be missed.
steps: Play the story until Breakfast Run appears.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are main-path, so it arrives as you work through the story.
steps: Play the story until The Cartel Heist appears.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It is a main-path mission, so it unlocks as you play through the story.
steps: Play the story until Child's Play appears.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. It is a main-path mission, so it unlocks as you play through the story.
steps: Play the story until Headliners appears.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. It is a main-path mission at Vice City International Airport, so it unlocks as you play through the story.
steps: Play the story until VCIA Takedown appears.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a main-path mission, so it unlocks as you play through the story.
steps: Play the story until Operation Savage Glory appears.
Complete the mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game Progress checklist, which opens after the story. The checklist counts story progress, criminal activities, exploration and collectibles — but only a slice of each category, so you do not need literally everything. Reported checklist pieces include 100 optional tasks, 200 base-model vehicles scanned, 100 animal species or variants studied, 70 of 80 challenges and all 42 Shooting Range gold medals. Expect roughly 200 hours: this is the last trophy for most hunters.
steps: Finish the story to open the Progress checklist.
Work the checklist categories: missions, robberies, gang operations, collectibles, races, stunts, challenges and discoveries.
Keep a manual save per chapter — there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts. Jumps, near-misses, drifts and airtime all count toward the tally, so fold them into normal driving and the count climbs on its own. Fast cars and bikes help, and stunt jumps around Leonida are worth chaining once you know the ramps.
steps: Drive fast, jump ramps and chain near-misses.
Watch the stunt counter in the Progress menu.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once. Fishing, bowling, arcade games, shooting ranges and races are among them: play one session of each type the game tracks and the trophy pops when the ninth different type registers. Check the Progress menu to see which types are still untried.
steps: Open Progress to see which activity types are still untried.
Play one session of each of the nine types.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. Each range holds several weapon drills and gold needs a high score, so learn each drill, use the right weapon and replay the ones you miss. Ranges open as you explore Leonida, so visit a new range whenever you pass one.
steps: Visit all 12 Shooting Ranges.
Gold every drill — 42 in total.
Replay drills until the gold threshold clears.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Drone races are time trials through rings: learn each course, cut corners where the rings allow and keep the drone low and fast. One win per location, fourteen in total.
steps: Find the 14 Top Fun Drone Race spots.
Win a race at each location.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Road, off-road and street races all count, but each race only counts once, so spread your wins across the map instead of replaying one favourite. Faster cars and clean racing lines matter more than aggression.
steps: Enter races across Leonida.
Win 20 distinct ones.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot, accept his challenge and out-fish him: steady reeling beats frantic reeling, and the right bait helps. It is available early, so do it while you are still in Chapter 1.
steps: Find Cal's fishing challenge.
Out-score him in the challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Walk into any arcade, pick a machine and play it through to its end screen. Any machine counts, so choose the one you find easiest.
steps: Find an arcade.
Play one game through to its end screen.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. His strand runs through the story's side missions: take each of his jobs in order and the trophy pops at the last one. Check the map for his marker whenever you are between story missions.
steps: Follow Andy's mission strand.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. His strand runs through the story's side missions: take each of his jobs in order and the trophy pops at the last one.
steps: Follow Kenton's mission strand.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. His strand runs through the story's side missions: take each of his jobs in order and the trophy pops at the last one.
steps: Follow Billy's mission strand.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands across Leonida. These are the wandering oddballs marked on the map: talk to them, follow each chain to its end and count eight finished strands. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have one, so their finals count toward this too.
steps: Pick up Strangers & Freaks encounters as you explore.
Finish 8 full strands.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. His strand runs through the story's side missions: take each of his jobs in order and the trophy pops at the last one.
steps: Follow Randy's mission strand.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. His strand runs through the story's side missions: take each of his jobs in order and the trophy pops at the last one.
steps: Follow Tyrone's mission strand.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: The first meditation, at Jason's house in Chapter 1, is gone after that chapter. No mission replay.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida: 18 meditations across 10 locations, tracked under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. Meditating at a spot with both Jason and Lucia counts twice. The trap is the very first meditation, in Chapter 1: the morning after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia mentions meditating in the kitchen at Jason's house. Follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. That spot is gone after Chapter 1, and the game has no mission replay. PowerPyx and GTABase both flag this as the game's only possibly missable trophy, though it is not yet confirmed that the trophy strictly needs that first meditation. Do it anyway and keep a manual Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.
steps: Chapter 1, morning after Down to Earth: talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house, follow her to the balcony, choose Accept.
Meditate at the remaining spots — bring your partner, each spot counts twice.
Track the counter in Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
Keep a manual save from Chapter 1 until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's strand points you at a one-of-a-kind animal: follow his missions until the hunt opens, then track the animal and take it down. Bring a scoped rifle and approach quietly.
steps: Follow Bret's mission strand until the hunt opens.
Track and hunt the unique animal.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida, in shops, hideouts and out in the world; each set needs every card in it. Pick them up as you explore and check the collection menu to see which sets are still short a card.
steps: Collect cards as you explore Leonida.
Check the collection menu for missing cards per set.
Complete 3 full sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK app and scan points of interest as you travel: landmarks, signs and curiosities all count. It climbs naturally if you scan whenever you pass something new, so make it a habit on every drive.
steps: Open the WAiNK app at points of interest.
Scan 100 different locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the small feats the game tracks — stunts, kills, driving feats and more. The counter rises as you play, and the last ones are worth hunting deliberately once the rest of the list is thin: check the challenge list and pick the ones closest to done.
steps: Play normally and let the challenge counter climb.
Open the challenge list late in the game and finish the nearest ones.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build heat with your partner beside you — rob a store or stir up trouble together — then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear. Alleys, tunnels and water all help you vanish.
steps: Get a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner beside you.
Break line of sight and hide until the stars clear.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Hit three shops in one run while your partner is with you, and keep at least one star the whole way: losing the heat between shops breaks the chain, so keep moving and keep the pressure on.
steps: Bring your partner and pick three shops close together.
Rob all three in one run while keeping a Wanted Level.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Every new car, bike, boat and aircraft you drive counts the first time you get in it, so drive everything you see. Car parks, docks and airfields are the fastest way to rack up new models.
steps: Drive every new vehicle you find.
Check the vehicle menu for the discovery count.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Find a busy firefight, trigger Combat Focus with a group clustered together and chain the kills before the meter runs out. Gang hideouts and police standoffs give you the crowd you need.
steps: Find a firefight with several enemies grouped together.
Trigger Combat Focus and down 5 before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Get to Vice City International Airport and leave by an unscheduled route: steal a plane on the airfield or slip out through the runways instead of using the terminal. Any departure that is not on the schedule counts.
steps: Go to Vice City International Airport.
Leave by an unscheduled route, such as stealing a plane.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino military tank and put it to work. Per U7BUY, the trophy is about taking control of a Rhino; the exact combat requirement is still being pinned down, so treat it as: steal a Rhino from a military base and cause havoc with its cannon. From the official description, not yet checked in the game.
steps: Find a Rhino tank at a military base.
Take control of it and use its cannon.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses raising the alarm. Grab the goods and slip out before anyone knows you were there. A suppressed weapon and a quick exit help.
steps: Pick a jewelry store.
Rob it without triggering an alarm or being spotted.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Bank vaults are the big heists: crack each vault, grab the cash and get clear of the police before the escape window closes. Plan your getaway car before you go in.
steps: Find a bank vault robbery.
Crack the vault and escape the police.
Repeat for 5 vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, crack it open and lose the heat that follows. Trucks run set routes, so wait for one on a quiet stretch and hit it fast.
steps: Find an Armored Truck on its route.
Rob it and escape the police.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 named areas. Drive, fly and walk into every corner of the map; the area counter ticks up as each new place registers. A plane or helicopter makes the far corners quick work.
steps: Travel to every named area of Leonida.
Watch the area counter in the Progress menu.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Find each gang's operation on the map, hit it and get out. One per gang, nine in total, so check the map for the gangs you have not hit yet.
steps: Find an Illegal Operation for each gang.
Rob one operation per gang — 9 in total.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view: a quiet moment that pops the trophy. It is available early, so do it on your first trip to the beach.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach.
Order a cocktail at a beachfront bar with a view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Get inside a vehicle showroom, then drive straight out through the glass: the classic GTA exit. Per U7BUY, the trophy is the special showroom escape, and the precise setup is still being confirmed, so try it in a showroom with a car already inside. From the official description, not yet checked in the game.
steps: Enter a vehicle showroom.
Drive out through the glass in classic style.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go bowling there and finish a game: the follow-through is the point. It is available early, so knock it out on a quiet evening between missions.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a game of bowling through to the end.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Raise both Jason's and Lucia's Strength attributes to maximum. Train Strength with both characters — gyms and physical work build it — until both bars are full. Per U7BUY, this is the trophy's requirement: max Strength on both partners.
steps: Train Strength with Jason until it is maxed.
Train Strength with Lucia until it is maxed.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices that affect your Criminal Profile. Every decision that shifts your profile counts: GTABase puts the count at 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. It climbs across a full playthrough, so keep choosing — dialogue picks, side-job decisions and approach choices all feed it. The counter is in the profile menu.
steps: Keep making choices that shift your Criminal Profile.
Check the profile counter in the menu.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Trigger a hidden second-chance event. The exact method is still unverified: PowerPyx marks this one as not yet known, so play naturally and watch for a moment where a failed attempt gets a second chance. From the official description, not yet checked in the game.
steps: Play through the game and watch for a second-chance moment.
If a setup fails, try it again right away.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Experience a mysterious hidden encounter somewhere in Leonida. The trigger is still unverified: PowerPyx lists it as not yet known, so treat it as a rare world event to stumble on while exploring — the kind of thing that makes you stop and ask what just happened. From the official description, not yet checked in the game.
steps: Explore Leonida's odd corners: deserts, swamps and back roads.
Watch for a strange encounter and play it out.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Strike someone with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The precise conditions are still under investigation (U7BUY), so try a drive-by melee hit on a pedestrian from a slow-moving car. From the official description, not yet checked in the game.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a car.
Drive slowly past a pedestrian and land a melee hit from the vehicle.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies: pass them to your contacts to clean them, and the total adds up across the game. Big heists give the biggest stacks, so this one finishes itself if you rob often.
steps: Rob banks, trucks and stores to collect Marked Bills.
Launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Clothes, weapons, food and cars all count: big purchases late in the game finish it off quickly, so save the expensive shopping for the cleanup phase.
steps: Shop as you play.
Make big purchases late in the game to reach $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties: all 8 of them. Buy each garage as it becomes available; they double as vehicle storage, so they are worth owning anyway.
steps: Find each garage property for sale.
Buy all 8.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Drive a vehicle, open the Scooter Bros app and register it: ten different vehicles in total. Mix cars, bikes and anything else you find.
steps: Drive a vehicle you have not registered yet.
Open the Scooter Bros app and register it.
Repeat for 10 vehicles.
